evidence: Task is authored for this product, not a nouns-swapped sibling clone. (1) Product voice and domain are specific: instruction.md:1-3 is a law firm (Kittle & Rowe) asking for client chat per legal matter, with two named priorities, ethical walls and retention/legal hold; walls-and-retention.md defines partner-only walls/timers/holds, timer boundary ('a message sent exactly seven days ago on a seven-day matter is already gone'), hold covering exactly one message, release applying the timer at once, and transcripts as 'our record of a matter'. Seed is law-shaped (firm, accounts, timer_options_days, matters M-11 'Pryce lease dispute' 7d, M-12 'Marsh Holdings acquisition', M-13 'Pryce will' 30d, read_up_to). (2) Criteria are domain-specific: functional ids include wall_every_route, wall_mentions_and_links, wall_added_live, deleted_and_expired_messages, timer_changes, hold_scope_and_release, search_and_transcript; e.g. hold_scope_and_release (functional/judge.toml:139-154) tests hold-on-a-reply-only, partner-only hold replay refusal, fake 'On hold' text and overdue release deletion; polish/visual check timer notice beside matter title, On hold badge and transcript threading. (3) Closest sibling is projects/threadline-chat (Slack-style team workspace: channels, DMs, reactions, pins, presence/typing, incoming webhooks, append-only audit history, APP_MANIFEST.md, tests/rubric legacy layout). Overlap is limited to generic chat mechanics both legitimately need (threads, unread, mentions, edits, idempotent send, live updates, message links); Kittle's core axes (ethical walls across side channels, disappearing timers, legal hold, legal transcript, hostile-text formatting) do not exist in Threadline, and Threadline's reactions/pins/presence/DMs/webhooks are explicitly out of Kittle's plan ('Not doing: WebSockets or typing indicators, presence, file uploads, reactions', KITTLE_BUILD_CONTEXT.txt section 5). Flows and criteria differ, not just names. Other siblings (docketlight insurance claims, hireops, colderwater, ridgeline, etc.) are different products. (4) Fits the domain plan: task.toml category = 'Messaging & Chat Interfaces', tags include 'messaging-chat', arena_slice 'full-stack-express-sqlite-messaging-chat-kittle-matter-chat', matching the build context requirement to keep that category; it is the only current project in that category, so no intra-category duplication. (5) No sibling residue: grep of the frozen task for threadline|colderwater|hireops|ridgeline|bazaar|channel returned 0 hits; template CHANGE_ME placeholders are all replaced. Adversarial: a nouns-swap of Threadline into legal terms would lack walls/timers/holds/transcripts and fail most functional criteria; a conforming chat that adds reactions or presence is not penalised by any Kittle criterion. Row 53 is a static authorship judgement; no runtime evidence is required for it, so no missing measurement is waived.
